claims.claim: Engine, suspension and body parts for all model of Acura and Honda cars and SUVs.
claims.evidence: Witness only saw a single grey Honda Accord interior trim/panel piece; no evidence of engine/suspension/body parts or “all models” compatibility.
No documentation, labels, shipping marks, or other proof shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: The witness report shows an interior trim/panel piece, not an engine/suspension component; “working/no knock/low mileage/never opened” cannot be verified from the observed item.

risks.risk: Wrong exact part/variant or wrong fitment for the buyer’s specific Honda Accord year/trim; mounting holes/cut-outs may not align.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number/label (or stamping) and a close-up showing all mounting points/clip locations compared to the buyer’s car side.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used interior trim piece with uncertain compatibility (assume possible mismatch and missing/incorrect fasteners).

risks.risk: Hidden damage: cracks, hairline breaks, warping, or missing mounting clips/fasteners not visible in the single overview shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the entire panel edges and mounting holes from multiple angles, plus a clip/fastener inventory photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/needs replacement clips or may not mount securely.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition issues (scratches, fading, stains, prior repairs) that affect resale value and buyer satisfaction.
risks.proof: Under strong light, straight-on and angled photos of the full surface (front/back) showing any scratches, discoloration, or repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst cosmetic case for used trim (visible wear).

risks.risk: Left/right or side-specific placement mismatch (some trims differ by side or location).
risks.proof: A photo showing any side-specific markings and the full shape context (where it sits in the car), or a comparison photo to the buyer’s removed part.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/uncertain side fit until confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of any part number/label/stamping on the panel (and the back side).
Send clear photos of all mounting holes and edges, plus whether clips/fasteners are included.
Send photos showing the full surface condition (front and back) under bright light to confirm no cracks/warping/stains.
Confirm the exact Accord year/trim this panel fits (or show it installed in the car / alongside the buyer’s removed part).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item only as a Honda Accord interior trim/panel, but key pricing drivers—exact variant/fitment and condition (cracks/warping/missing clips)—are not shown. Without those missing shots, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
